sharedScenario.title: A secret plan is revealed
sharedScenario.context: During a community meeting, someone asks the characters to disclose a secret plan before any more choices are made.
sharedScenario.keyQuestion: How can the group decide freely and safely?

characterACandidates.interpretation: A choice is needed under uncertainty.
characterACandidates.action: Deflect with a playful question, then explain part of the plan.
characterACandidates.underlyingNeed: Keep others safe without losing freedom.
characterACandidates.possibleUpside: Could restore trust through an intentional choice.
characterACandidates.possibleTradeoff: Could unsettle people expecting a simpler answer.
